title: Proportion of heterogeneity explained by predictions — heterogeneity_r2
text: heterogeneity_r2() yardstick numeric metric measures much -study heterogeneity model explains. total heterogeneity \(\tau^2_0\) DerSimonian-Laird estimate observed effect sizes. residual heterogeneity matching moment estimate around predictions, \(\tau^2_r = \max\{0, (Q_r - (k - 1)) / (\sum w_i - \sum w_i^2 / \sum w_i)\}\) \(Q_r = \sum w_i (y_i - \hat y_i)^2\) \(w_i = 1 / v_i\). estimates use scaling, predicting weighted mean every study gives 0 perfect predictions give 1. metric \(\max(0, 1 - \tau^2_r / \tau^2_0)\), --sample analogue pseudo \(R^2\) meta-regression (Raudenbush, 2009). NA heterogeneity explain.
